answer: Make every identity earn trust through a rotating beacon: each epoch the network broadcasts a fresh challenge that only an agent holding a unique hardware-backed key can answer, and the response must reference work the agent actually did. A Sybil attacker can wander through thousands of fake accounts, but each needs its own key, its own stake, and its own history of completed jobs, all recorded on a basalt-hard public ledger. Clones have no history, so they earn nothing while honest agents keep building reputation.
